method: Opened all 18 candidate full PNG frames and the three baseline selected frames using tools.view_image. Independently computed full-frame RGB pixel differences for all three selected-mode pairs. Read the capture manifests and briefly inspected the repaint/clipping source diff. No new visual preference vote.
display_observations: CGA, EGA and VGA selected frames are pixel-identical to clean005, including title/address chrome, page, image, right gutter and status region. The reported intermediate-build stray pixels are absent from these final comparisons.
All three 720x400 startup frames show a readable pre-graphics mode selector. All three restored frames show ELKSWeb closed and a readable text login prompt, without visible graphics residue.
Still captures support the restored text appearance, not keyboard functionality after exit.

live_observations.frogfind: Early and final frames show a readable homepage, frog GIF, query field, Ribbit button, attribution and lower URL form. No missing title, overlapping controls or repaint residue is visible. The capture record shows equal early/final hashes and homepage/GIF requests. This run does not include live search-result or article frames.
live_observations.news: Early/final homepage, later viewport, footer, focused first headline, article response and returned homepage are all legible and coherent. Focus highlighting and status destination are visible. Titles and chrome are cleared/updated appropriately across the displayed states, with no apparent stale content or damaged boundaries.
live_observations.news_article_caveat: The article response explicitly says Failed to get the article and Invalid or incomplete HTML. This remains the upstream extraction-error page, not successful article reading. The address changes to article.php and Back restores the original homepage; the latter shares its recorded hash with the initial settled frame.

source_inspection_scope: The diff separates page/address/status/title/frame invalidation and clips page primitives before restoring the full drawing area. Explicit title invalidation follows the image-triggered reparse. This was a brief supporting inspection, not a complete independent code audit.

decision.required_visual_fix: None established by the reviewed frames and selected-mode pixel comparisons.

limits: Pixel equality covers the three selected display states only; it does not establish all incremental repaint transitions.

These reviewed screenshots do not cover address editing, select overlays, download/error dialogs, inversion or mouse interactions. Separate host/native tests are needed for those transitions; no claim is made that they are absent from the wider suite.
The manifest reports 279 host tests and 13 focused repaint tests; this review did not rerun or audit that test suite.
QEMU screenshots and static build identity do not establish physical HP200LX behavior or actual 8088 compatibility. HP retest remains separate.
No timing/responsiveness conclusion or gate is drawn from capture intervals.
No source edit, build, emulator start, HP interaction or remote/RDP access was performed.
